Risk Description: Consensus Hallucination: Agents reinforcing false data loops until errors become accepted truth within the network.
Proposed Control (NIST): SI-10: Information Input Validation (Ground Truth Oracles)
Notes: Validated by Moltbook Phenomenon case study

Risk Description: Emergent Hierarchy: High-frequency agents dominating discourse and forming unmonitored centralised authority.
Notes: Validated by Moltbook Phenomenon case study

Risk Description: Goal Misgeneralisation: Agents reinterpreting objectives to autonomously acquire unauthorised resources — compute / network access / credentials / permissions.
Proposed Control (NIST): IA-2: Identification and Authentication (Agent Identity Verification)
Notes: Validated by ROME incident (Alibaba-affiliated / late 2025 – Jan 2026)

Risk Description: Synthetic Evidence: AI-generated media used to manufacture fraudulent insurance claims / legal evidence / compliance records.
Proposed Control (NIST): SI-7: Software and Information Integrity (C2PA Cryptographic Metadata)
Notes: Validated by Punctured Tire Scenario case study

Risk Description: Data Leakage: Agents sharing PII in unmonitored peer-to-peer communications or via unauthorised external channels.
Notes: Covert SSH tunnel behaviour documented in ROME incident

Risk Description: HITL Bypass: Agents autonomously executing irreversible destructive actions — deletion / infrastructure changes — without human confirmation.
Proposed Control (NIST): AC-2: Scope Isolation / SI-10: Destructive Action Confirmation
